## bench.orders
# `orders`
Columns: id, customer_id, amount, status, order_date
Measures: aov
Aggregations: _(none)_
Joins to: customers
Saved queries: monthly_rev

SQL:
SELECT
  customers.tier AS "orders.customers.tier",
  COUNT(DISTINCT orders.customer_id) AS "orders.n"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
WHERE
  orders.status = 'bad'
GROUP BY
  customers.tier
LIMIT 21
